correctness.rationale: The complete graph equations reduce bijectively to at most four free period-four bits in each family. The binary n-congruence conditions are imposed on original equations; all cases and multiplicities are enumerated. The two independently implemented checkers using row reduction and direct Gray-code neighborhood toggles respectively agreed for n=3..80 and n=3..11. These are corroborations of the all-order proof in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: A natural optimization question for the canonical all-on Lights-Out state gives an infinite sharp contrast between two equally sized cubic ladder families. Changing just the seam changes the minimum by a factor of two, in opposite directions as n crosses the two even residue classes. The exact all-solution weights, rather than just existence or rank, determine configuration-dependent cost and multiplicity.
